name: ruins-clarity-v1
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Production asset for the 2D game DontEraseMe. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not merely a reference. Image 2 is the approved CLARITY STANDARD only: take its decisive hand-inked edges, calm larger color masses, and restrained wear, not its architecture or layout.
Keep the target's exact composition, framing, scale, subject identities, palette and lighting hierarchy. Do not redesign. Improve clarity through simpler purposeful marks, not an artificial sharpening filter. Remove about two thirds of the dense tiny fibers, mottled micro-noise and random pepper wear. Subject: exact existing abandoned night ruin border around a completely empty dark courtyard, landscape 3:2. Do not move decoration inward or make a new geometric border. Empty center occupies the same broad area. Keep muted charcoal and warm ash/taupe planes; the ruins remain visibly ruined but use fewer tiny fragments in the rendering. Redraw wall corners, stair treads, railing contours and bare tree shapes with the clarity standard. No characters, enemies, paint marks, UI or items in the center.
